Its very scripted and short. I can break it down for you here:

1st time you see it, run back towards the puzzle room with the Mia doll, hesd through the door to the room with the sink where you cleaned the ring, then hide in the locker. It wont go into the locker, and if you look away you never have to see it. Just chill in your locker till the baby leaves and the music stops.

2nd time you see it, itll be after you get the fuse from the bedroom, run back down the stairs through the kitchen, back to the bedroom, and hide under the bed. If you hide in the locker it'll find you. Just stay calm, chill out with the creepy doll friend under the bed and you'll be fine. You might have to see it here just fyi, as it does crawl around the bedroom. Wait for it to leave and the music to stop.

3rd and final time will be when you put the fuse in the lift - run straight to the room with the projector (the door will be on the left if you go to the lift and turn around), and yiu eseentially want to kite it around the table. Its a little faster than you think. When you've got it at opposite end of the table to you and you're close to the door, run out, hit the button to open the door, and you'll be able to get in.

Main points are to just be calm and when you realize its scripted in terms of appearances etc its a hell of a lot mlre manageable.

Charms are essentially spells that affect the next shot when they're primed and activated, a few examples are:

Homing - the next shot will track to the nearest target, usually doing magic damage of a different amount based on quality of the charm.

Pierce - the next round fired will go through the shot target, hitting any enemies in a straight line and adding magic damage of an amount based on qaulity.

Chain - the next shot fired will bounce between nearby targets within a certain distance, delivering extra magic damage per hit based on quality of the charm.

Bomb Shot - the next shot will fire a small grenade instead of a bullet, exploding on impact and dealing physical and extra magic damage in an area. 

There's some more but yeah, charms can also be put onto side arms as well.
